conditions.text: C1 — 1.1.53 ङिच्च: a ṅit substitute (ādeśa), even one of several sounds, replaces only the LAST sound of the sthānin. It is the apavāda of 1.1.55 (sarvādeśa). Scope = a substitute that carries the anubandha ङ् and replaces a 6th-case sthānin of more than one sound.

quotes.quote: ङिच्च य आदेशः, सोऽनेकालपि अलोऽन्त्यस्य स्थाने भवति।

conditions.text: C2 — Where the ङ् has another job (e.g. तातङ् 7.1.35, whose ङ् blocks guṇa/vṛddhi), 1.1.53 is set aside and 1.1.55 makes the substitute replace the whole.

quotes.quote: यत्र हि ङ्कारस्य प्रयोजनान्तरमपि सम्भाव्यते तत्र'ङ्च्चि'  इत्येतदनन्यार्थङ्त्वेष्विनङदिषु सावकाशं बाधित्वा ठनेकाल्शित्सर्वस्यऽ इत्येतद्भवति, यथा तातङ्

conditions.text: C3 — The string "ङिच्च" also occurs in texts that have nothing to do with 1.1.53: the Bhāṣya maxim "ङिच्च पिन्न" (a ṅit [sārvadhātuka] is not pit, and vice versa), the words of 3.4.103 यासुट् … ङिच्च (yāsuṭ is ṅit), and the uṇādi sūtra context of सखि. A commentator quoting any of these is not invoking 1.1.53.

quotes.quote: तस्माद्वक्तव्यं पिन्न ङिद्भवति ङिच्च पिन्न भवतीति
परस्मैपदविषयस्य लिङो यासुडागमो भवति, स चोदात्तो भवति, ङिच्च।
